admissionRules: The instance must bind to ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION and LEGAL_AUDIT.
The instance must be approved or active before runtime use.
Exactly one deterministic retention rule mode must be present.
The client must not select or override the rule.
The selected policyVersion is persisted immutably on ENT-CONSENT.
No AUTH-001 runtime registration may persist ENT-CONSENT while the applicable policy instance is absent or unresolved.
Approval and provenance must be traceable to a current repository artifact.
nonAuthorizations: The 730-day value is not inferred from law or jurisdiction-specific compliance requirements.
No public privacy notice may represent 730 days as a legal requirement.
No production runtime authorization is created by this development-only instance.
No Mapping 0 GREEN or Evidence Registry promotion is implied.
No new Worker/D1/Queue or Payload Core change is authorized by this admission.

governanceBaseline.boundary: Governance baseline plus an explicitly development-only deterministic test policy; production legal/compliance authority remains pending.

productionMissingInputs: production legal/compliance authority and approval for the applicable retention schedule
production policy version/scope/effective period replacing the development-only instance

runtimeAuthorization.development: AUTH-001 development/integration validation may use the admitted deterministic test policy
